topics.title: Batch Tracking, Expiry Management & FEFO Principle
topics.objective: Manage pharmaceutical stock across batch numbers, enforcing First-Expiry-First-Out dispensing rules.
topics.example: SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE drug_id = 42 ORDER BY expiry_date ASC LIMIT 1;
topics.exercise: Write a stock picking algorithm prioritizing batches expiring within the next 60 days.

topics.title: Controlled Substances Ledger & Prescription Verification
topics.objective: Enforce strict verification, perpetual inventory reconciliation, and dual-signoff on controlled narcotics.
topics.exercise: Implement a dual-verification workflow requiring two distinct licensed pharmacist signatures for Schedule II drugs.

topics.title: Barcoded Medication Administration (BCMA) Verification
topics.objective: Validate the 5 Rights of medication dispensing (Right Patient, Drug, Dose, Route, Time) via barcode scans.
topics.exercise: Build an automated dispensing check preventing medication handover if the scanned NDC code differs from the prescription.

topics.title: Automated Reorder Point Calculation & Supplier POs
topics.objective: Calculate dynamic safety stocks based on average daily consumption and supplier lead times.
topics.exercise: Create a daily cron job generating draft Purchase Orders for items breaching calculated reorder thresholds.

topics.title: Vaccine & Biologics Temperature Telemetry
topics.objective: Monitor 2°C - 8°C cold-chain pharmaceutical refrigerators and trigger immediate breach alarms.
topics.exercise: Write an alert listener invalidating vaccine batch validity when temperature excursions exceed 45 minutes.
